_notes: Chapter 1, beat 5: Jonah on Signal Hill. He lies about when he last saw Katherine; the café CCTV still catches him.
entries: checked top to bottom, the first whose 'if' passes picks the start node.
nodes: each has 'lines', then either 'choices' (topics) or 'next' (a node id, or 'end').
A line with 'statement' goes on record. 'contradictions' says which evidence catches which statement.
effects happen the first time a node plays. 'no_present' switches the Present button off for that node.
partner: who James is talking to (a key from portraits.json). Used for the folder heading 'Present to ...' and to face that person when evidence is shown.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: You're the photo man. From the insurance archive.

lines.speaker: james
lines.text: James Flint. I'm looking for Katherine Marr.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: Half the hill's looking for her. Doesn't mean she wants finding.

choices.text: When did you last see Katherine?
What do you do up here?
What did she say about the photograph?

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: Tuesday. She came by the darkroom for some old contact sheets.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: I haven't seen her since Tuesday.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: I keep the darkroom going. It was my great-aunt's.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: Ines. She died last month. Fell in the signal tower. You'll have heard.

lines.speaker: james
lines.text: The café camera. Thursday, 21:32. That's you at her table.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: That camera's been broken for a year.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: ...Fine. Thursday. She was shaking. She asked me to bring her something to eat and not to tell anyone I'd seen her.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: I don't know where she's sleeping. And I'm not lying about that.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: That it wasn't her. She's been saying it for years. Nobody listens to the girl from the photograph.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: And that the new print was wrong. Wrong like someone did it on purpose.

lines.speaker: jonah
lines.text: Mind the ice on the way down.

wrong_present.speaker: jonah
wrong_present.text: I don't know what you want me to say about that.

wrong_present.speaker: jonah
wrong_present.text: That's got nothing to do with me.

wrong_present.speaker: james
wrong_present.text: No. That isn't what he's hiding.
